messages.author: Aino Asiantuntija
messages.text: FYI: TX-2000 firmware 4.2 release notes say it fixes forwarding table re-initialisation after optical module hot-swap. That's the stuck-traffic-after-SFP-swap thing Erkki found on TRN-042. TRN-042 got 4.2 on 20 Sep. Units still on 4.1 or older still need the interface disable/enable trick.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Good news. Agree - keep doing the bounce on anything below 4.2.
